name: second-brain
description: Docs-in-sync system: skills, a read-only docs reader agent, an end-of-session Stop hook, and a SessionStart bootstrap nudge, plus a deterministic git-bash bootstrap that scaffolds the repo-side files (docs/second-brain/, CLAUDE.md block, git pre-commit and pre-push, CI) into a destination project. SB_GATE selects whether the blocking check runs at commit time or over the whole branch at push time.
